## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

Link related issues (use `Closes #123` when appropriate).

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/ci/run.sh` passed, or explain the failure below.
- [ ] Update documentation when commands or behavior change.
- [ ] Add user-facing changes to `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`, or explain why no entry is needed.
- [ ] Add regression coverage for changed behavior, when applicable.
- [ ] Examples and logs contain no personal data, credentials, or private captures.

Include relevant test results and any deployment or migration considerations.
